'''Gabrel Treon''' was a historian who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Biography==
Treon wrote an extensive historical article called "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," which focused on the powerful [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]]. The article was later published in the ''[[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]]'', around [[104 ABY]].<ref name="Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
